rachel: Quick pulse 10min sync: gear up a tight "benchmark lab" for launch collateral. Need 3 visuals + 2 headline angles + simple routing rules. Can we keep runs small?
diego: yes. propose slices: short-chat, long-context agent, embeddings lookup. small n (2 seeds) each.
anya: charts: 1) median vs $/1k tokens (points = variants), 2) p50-p99 latency stair for two slices, 3) cost-per-request bars (baseline vs cache+batch).
sam: copy variants: A) "Ship responsive apps at predictable unit cost." B) "Lower inference spend without slowing users."
rachel: include a micro-calculation for sales: show both per-1k and per-1M token numbers. keep ranges ("up to 50%") unless appendix proves exact.
diego: bench-bot example command for quick-run:
```
/bench quick --model rwd-mini --slices short,long,embed --tokens 3000 --seeds 2 --out ./out
```
anya: inbound routing bullets: tag "bench" on prompt upload; demo route if monthly tokens > 5M or asks private deploy; webinar RSVPs get CSV + one-sheet.
bench-bot: queued small runs. reply here with outputs; will auto-attach PNGs/CSV when ready. use `/bench --help` for flags.
rachel: timeline: visuals by Mon noon, copy Tue AM, webinar brief Wed. Diego + Anya pair on runs. I'll draft landing hook and inbound copy.
sam: social snippet: "See latency + unit cost on real slices 10min lab. Try it with your prompts."
diego: starting runs now, will post results.
anya: remember to keep chart axis labels minimal for creative to adapt.
rachel: thanks team 1 closing loop here.
